title: Brighter Than Gold

lyrics:
[Verse]
Woke up with the sky wide open
Every door I thought was broken
Swinging free, I'm letting go
Of every weight I used to hold

[Chorus]
We're brighter than gold
Burning through the cold
Hearts on fire, never old
We're brighter than gold

[Verse 2]
Hands up in the morning air
Strangers turning into friends out there
Every step a little higher
Every heartbeat lifting fire

[Bridge]
Higher, higher, can you feel it rise
Higher, higher, open up your eyes

[Chorus]
We're brighter than gold
Burning through the cold
